sources.title: Robust Queueing Theory
sources.authors: Chaithanya Bandi, Dimitris Bertsimas, Nataly Youssef
sources.access: author manuscript full text; publisher abstract and metadata
sources.inspected: Section 2, Equation (2), manuscript page 7 (PDF page index 6), introductory model and reference attribution to Lindley
sources.relevance: The reviewed FCFS system-time expression yields the completion envelope by adding the admitted arrival time and making service times equal.
sources.limit: This direct derivation concerns a fixed admitted subsequence; it does not establish the full tail-drop partition theorem as a stated result in this source.

sources.title: Synchronization and Linearity: An Algebra for Discrete Event Systems

sources.inspected: Section 7.2.1, printed pages 306-307, Equation (7.3) and Remark 7.1
sources.relevance: Max-plus event recurrence is connected to an infinite-buffer single-server FIFO queue.
sources.limit: The inspected example supplies a building block, not a stated finite tail-drop loss/deadline extremum theorem.

sources.title: Symbolic Computation of Schedulability Regions Using Parametric Timed Automata
sources.authors: Alessandro Cimatti, Luigi Palopoli, Yusi Ramadian
sources.inspected: Sections 4.1-4.2, Figure 3, and the stated decidable periodic-task special case
sources.relevance: Symbolic traces yield compatible timing-parameter regions, which are excluded iteratively to construct schedulability regions.
sources.limit: The reviewed objective is schedulability. General termination is not promised; its special-case result must not be generalized to arbitrary timed systems.

sources.title: Tools for Parametric Verification. A Comparison on a Case Study
sources.inspected: Sections 2.3-2.4 and 5.1-5.2, including the def_lost counter and TReX model/output
sources.relevance: Parametric counter/timed systems, symbolic configurations and FIFO channels support PGM loss-recovery analysis.
sources.limit: Loss counts are represented, but the reviewed synthesis target is recovery classification rather than our finite-trace combined failure extrema. Its FIFO communication model is not assumed identical to our tail-drop policy.

search_interpretation: These focused queries returned mostly adjacent stochastic or policy-optimization work, not an exact theorem match. Negative search results cannot establish absence. The closest positive evidence is the directly inspected standard recurrence and symbolic-region machinery.
remaining_review_question: Does the admission-only projection and capacity-dependent bound add a substantial theorem, or is it a routine corollary of the established building blocks?
assistant_desk_verdict: likely routine specialization; correctness supported, substantial novelty unestablished
decision: keep speedup route shelved and collection stopped; seek an independent expert assessment of the precise packet before further investment
